description: This Scala source file defines the ExecuteThreadRunner class responsible for managing execution threads in Spark SQL Connect, including starting, interrupting, and executing tasks within a dedicated thread, along with thread state management.

classes.name: ExecuteThreadRunner
classes.description: Manages execution threads for Spark SQL Connect, including starting, interrupting, and executing tasks with thread state management.

classes.name: ExecutionThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread, responsible for executing the main logic in a separate thread.

classes.name: ThreadState
classes.description: Object defining possible thread states and their transitions.

classes.name: ThreadStateInfo
classes.description: Case class representing the state of an execution thread with an integer transition state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the execution thread if not already started or interrupted.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the execution thread is currently alive.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Interrupts the execution thread if it is running, updating thread state accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method handling errors, session setup, plan execution, and finalization.

methods.name: executeInternal
methods.description: Performs the core execution logic, including plan handling and response management.

methods.name: shouldDelegateCompleteResponse
methods.description: Determines if the final response should be delegated to the listener thread based on request type.

methods.name: requestString
methods.description: Generates a debug string representation of the request, with redaction.

methods.name: createResultComplete
methods.description: Creates a protobuf message indicating execution completion.
